Round 2 · Implementation · Medium

Ticket #11 — Subscription Renewal

Difficulty: Medium

Context

You maintain monthly membership billing. A subscription has a scheduled due date and a fee in cents. An invoice ID identifies one collection attempt; replaying an invoice returns its saved outcome. A later collection after a decline uses a new invoice ID. The gateway in this exercise is a configurable fake.

Practice report

Create active subscription sub-1 for 1200 cents, due 2026-10-01. Configure the gateway to decline and call renew("sub-1", "invoice-2", "2026-10-01").

Observation Current starter Expected
Renewal result and saved invoice declined declined
Subscription status active past_due
Next due date 2026-10-01 2026-10-01

Support needs the subscription status to agree with the unpaid renewal.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Charge only a due subscription whose status is active or past_due. Early or canceled-subscription requests return not_due without a charge; an unknown subscription returns missing without creating an invoice.
  • A decline saves the invoice as declined, marks the subscription past_due, and preserves its scheduled due date.
  • A successful charge saves a paid invoice, sets the subscription active, and advances the scheduled due date by one month. Clamp the day to the last valid day of the target month; January 31, 2026 advances to February 28, 2026.
  • Replaying a recorded paid or declined invoice returns that outcome without another charge or date change. A newly identified attempt can collect after a decline and restore the subscription to active.
  • Rejected early, canceled, or missing-subscription requests preserve stored subscription and invoice state.

Out of Scope

Use ISO date strings and the included gateway. Proration, payment-method management, invoice ownership across subscriptions, and real payment retries are outside this ticket.

Investigation

Trace invoice outcomes, gateway calls, and subscription state on decline, success, replay, and an early request. Add focused tests that assert the due date and status together, including a new invoice after a decline and a month-end renewal.
